subject: Renewal: Support elevation & SLO proposal for ClearWave Health
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 10:15 AM -0700
Subject: Renewal options & support elevation for ClearWave Health

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. Your renewal with Redwood comes up in August and I wanted to lay out two sensible paths so Procurement can pick a lane early:

Option A — Standard renewal (status quo)
- Term: 12 months
- Same reserved capacity: 6 vCPU-equivalent slots / no guaranteed GPU pool
- Standard support: business hours, 24h severity-1 response target
- Cost: baseline renewal pricing (no uplift)

Option B — Support elevation (recommended for production latency SLOs)
- Term: 12 months + optional 12-month commit
- Premium SLA: 99.9% availability + targeted latency SLO for the main inference route (p95 under 180ms on pinned model)
- 24/7 premium support + named escalation contact and quarterly SLO reviews
- Dedicated capacity option: reserved GPU pool (3x unit increase) with burst buffer for peak ETL windows
- Pricing: ~15% uplift on token/instance blend; tiered credits for 12-month commit

I’ve attached a draft SOW and our SLA matrix to show exact measurements and credit language. If you want, we can also draft the contract language for the latency credit and escalation path.

Next step: Can you share the procurement timing and whether ClearWave prefers a PO first or Net-30 invoice? I’ll loop in Vanessa and Rishi from our side to finalize pricing and SOW language.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.com]

Attachments referenced: SOW_ClearWave_v2.pdf, redwood-sla-matrix.xlsx
From: Alex Torres <atorres@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>, Sofia Morales <sofia@cloudops.clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 13, 2027 at 09:04 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options & support elevation for ClearWave Health

Jordan — thanks for the clear options. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Latency SLO: we need p95 < 200ms for our "chart-render" route during business hours (M-F 6am–6pm PT). Is that achievable with the dedicated GPU pool?
2) Credits: what does Redwood define as an "SLO breach" (service unavailable vs latency window)? We need explicit credit triggers for procurement.
3) Procurement timeline: we aim to sign by July 15 to lock the August 1 renewal date. Procurement prefers a PO before invoicing.

Cc'ing Sofia (Cloud Ops) and Procurement. Please loop in whoever owns the SLA credit language.

— Alex
Alex Torres
Director, Engineering — ML Platform, ClearWave Health
atorres@clearwavehealth.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 14, 2027 at 08:32 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options & support elevation for ClearWave Health

Internal — quick plan to respond to Alex's points and get procurement comfortable: 

- We should propose concrete numbers: p95 target 180ms (business hours), p99 target 400ms; define measurement via our tracing hooks and GA distributed traces (Drive link in related_links).
- Breach definition: any rolling 30-day window where p95 exceeds target for >6 hours triggers credit. We can offer 10% service credit for first breach, 25% for second within rolling 90 days. Need legal to sign off on exact language (I can coordinate).
- Dedicated capacity: offer a "Starter Dedicated" bundle (3x reserved units) with a 3-month free trial on burst buffer, applies if they commit 12 months. This helps them test cost/latency before full commit.
- Pricing: Rishi — can you confirm the uplift bands and whether a 12-month commit can be converted to a prepaid discounted invoice?

I'll reply to Alex with these bullets and attach the SOW + invoice draft.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 15, 2027 at 11:20 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options & support elevation for ClearWave Health

Vanessa / Jordan — pricing confirmation: 

- Premium SLA uplift: 15% on the blended unit cost (applies to token usage + reserved instance amortized charge).
- Starter Dedicated (3 units): $8,000/month list; with 12-month commit -> effective $6,800/month (15% commit discount).
- If they prepay 12 months we can offer an additional 5% prepay credit.
- SLO credit language (draft): see redwood-sla-matrix.xlsx — we should surface the exact credit table to procurement.

I attached a draft invoice (invoice-draft-CW-2027.pdf) and updated SOW with the Starter Dedicated option. If Legal needs any non-standard credit caps, flag for escalation.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Torres <atorres@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>, Sofia Morales <sofia@cloudops.clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, Apr 16, 2027 at 02:47 PM -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options & support elevation for ClearWave Health

Thanks Vanessa / Rishi — that helps. A couple of items Procurement asked us to confirm before we route a PO: 

• Can Redwood commit to the p95 < 200ms during business hours for the chart-render route if we take Starter Dedicated? If yes, put that in SOW with a monitoring integration checklist.
• Contract language: we need the exact breach definition and the pin for how credits are calculated (percent of monthly invoice tied to failed route).
• Named escalation contact and phone number for severity-1 incidents.

Procurement also asked for a draft PO template and the invoice to attach. I attached Procurement's timeline (we expect PO by July 7).

On the monitoring checklist: Sofia, can you share the telemetry endpoints and whether you need any tracing keys?

— Alex

On Fri, Apr 16, 2027 at 11:20 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Vanessa: confirming we'll add the monitoring checklist and named escalation contact in the SOW. Jordan, can you add Rishi's pricing table to the invoice so Procurement has the exact line items?

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@clearwavehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>, Sofia Morales <sofia@cloudops.clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 19, 2027 at 09:08 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options & support elevation for ClearWave Health

Alex / team — great, next steps and commitments from Redwood below: 

1) SOW: attached SOW_ClearWave_v2.pdf — includes Starter Dedicated (3 units), monitoring checklist, named escalation contact, and explicit p95/p99 targets. We commit to p95 < 180ms (business hours) when Starter Dedicated is provisioned and benchmarked during onboarding.

2) Breach and credits: we propose the following (also in SLA matrix): first breach in rolling 30-day window -> 10% monthly credit on route-specific invoice line; second breach within 90 days -> 25% credit; aggregate credit capped at 50% of that month’s line item. Legal has reviewed this draft and flagged no fundamental blockers.

3) Pricing & invoice: attached invoice-draft-CW-2027.pdf with line items per Rishi's table. We include an optional prepay discount row if you choose 12-month prepayment.

4) Procurement / PO: we can accept a PO before invoicing. If Procurement needs a PO template, Jordan will send a fillable PO template by end of week.

5) Timeline: onboarding window — provision Starter Dedicated within 10 business days of signed PO; benchmarking + SLO sign-off within 5 business days after provisioning.

Please review attachments and let us know whether Procurement wants the 12-month commit (best $/unit) or to proceed with an initial 3-month trial of the Starter Dedicated. If everything looks good we can schedule a contract redline call with Legal next week.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a PO.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_ClearWave_v2.pdf, redwood-sla-matrix.xlsx, invoice-draft-CW-2027.pdf
